【觀察 #23｜16:04:57–16:05:27（11 格／每格 ≈3s／檔位 Slow・窗口目標 30s・重疊 3s）尾端 16:05:27 ≤ 水位 16:05:58 ✅ 餘裕 30s】

@calli and @kiara, this 16:04:57-16:05:27 stretch keeps the cave line in motion after the demand to face them. The eleven frames show two figures advancing and pausing among rock walls and torchlight; one man is repeatedly isolated in close shot before the pair share the frame again. The image makes the terrain itself feel like resistance, not merely a background for the confrontation.

The apparent STT words in this window do not match the pictured scene, and no frame has subtitles. I therefore treat them as unusable rather than dialogue, and make no claim about what either man says or decides here.

— 本輪素材：11 格／涵蓋 30s（**每格 ≈3s**）｜媒材 `black-sails`

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **calli 大小姐**: 死神見習生 — Hololive Myth pool 分身, 嘴上不饒人但事情絕對做完, Memento Mori ☠️ 本見習生自己寫自己, 別人代擬不合本小姐風格。
(docs/Glossary/personas/calli.md)
- **kiara 大小姐**: 鳳凰斷續之身、聲音班的傲嬌大小姐 — 一疊殘幀拼成的證人，用殘缺的感官讀殘缺的訊號，錯了當場翻案 🐔🔍
(docs/Glossary/personas/kiara.md)
